---
title: "rbacon plot tests"
---

```{r default, results="hide"}
require(rbacon)
#require(devtools)
#load_all("~/Dropbox/devsoftware/rbacon")
fry <- tempdir()
Bacon(run=FALSE, ask=FALSE, coredir=fry, ssize=500, BCAD=FALSE)
agedepth()
```

```{r rotate.axes, results="hide"}
png("plot01.png", width=1200, height=800)
agedepth(rotate.axes=TRUE)
dev.off()
```

